snp1.11:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Vijayasutta. Caraṃ vā yadi vā tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno uda vā sayaṃ sammiñjeti pasāreti, -- esā kāyassa iñjanā. || ||
snp1.11:2.1: Aṭṭhīnahārusaññutto tacamaṃsāvalepano chaviyā kāyo paṭicchanno yathābhūtaṃ na dissati, || ||
snp1.11:3.1: antapūro udarapūro yakapeḷassa vatthino hadayassa papphāsassa vakkassa pihakassa ca || ||
snp1.11:4.1: siṃghānikāya khelassa sedassa medassa ca lohitassa lasikāya pittassa ca vasāya ca. || ||
snp1.11:5.1: Ath' assa navahi sotehi asucī savati sabbadā: akkhimhā akkhigūthako, kaṇṇamhā kaṇṇagūthako, || ||
snp1.11:6.1: siṃghāṇikā ca nāsāto, mukhena vamat' ekadā pittaṃ semhañ ca vamati, kāyamhā sedajallikā. || ||
snp1.11:7.1: Ath' assa susiraṃ sīsaṃ matthaluṅgassa pūritam, subhato naṃ maññatī bālo avijjāya purakkhato. || ||
snp1.11:8.1: Yadā ca so mato seti uddhumāto vinīlako apaviddho susānasmiṃ, anapekhā honti ñātayo, || ||
snp1.11:9.1: khādanti naṃ supāṇā ca sigālā ca vakā kimī, kākā gijjhā ca khādanti, ye c' aññe santi pāṇayo. || ||
snp1.11:10.1: Sutvāna Buddhavacanaṃ bhikkhu paññāṇavā idha, so kho maṃ parijānāti, yathābhūtaṃ hi passati. || ||
snp1.11:11.1: ‘Yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ, yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ,' ajjhattañ ca bahiddhā ca kāye chandaṃ virājaye. || ||
snp1.11:12.1: Chandarāgaviratto so bhikkhu paññāṇavā idha ajjhagā amataṃ santiṃ nibbāna-padam accutaṃ. || ||
snp1.11:13.1: Dipādako 'yam asuci duggandho parihīrati nānākuṇapaparipūro vissavanto tato tato. || ||
snp1.11:14.1: Etādisena kāyena yo maññe uṇṇametave paraṃ vā avajāneyya -- kim aññatra adassanā ti || || VIJAYASUTTAṂ
